New built-up land came from: vegetation 54%, agriculture 36%, bare soil 10%, water 1%.

Read with care. A 5-channel U-Net trained on Dynamic World labels classified two Sentinel-2 composites (Jan to Mar of each year, 10 m). Checked against 150 hand-labeled points in Hyderabad (2024 only), it matched 81% of them; Dynamic World matched 70%. Change between years has not been checked by hand. Net change is the more reliable number. Built-up loss (not drawn) and part of the gross gain come from bare, dry ground read as built-up, not from demolition. Vegetation includes scrub and open land.
